review_items.extraction_note: IMPORTANT: This item describes a specific, verifiable transparency/governance concern rather than typical subjective review sentiment — a student reportedly filed an RTI (Right to Information request, a formal Indian legal mechanism) regarding placement statistics, and the resulting official report reportedly showed a discrepancy between institute-published and RTI-obtained average CTC figures, as well as a large gap between average and median figures. This is recorded factually as reported by the source, without independent verification of the RTI report itself, and is NOT classified as ordinary 'negative sentiment' but flagged distinctly given its more substantive, factual nature.
